info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Advanced Voice Services Operational Actions API
info.description: This API facilitates operational actions for advanced voice services within banking channels. It allows authorized users to initiate, manage, and monitor various operations critical to enhancing customer engagement through voice technologies. Typical consumers of this API include banking application developers and systems integrators looking to automate voice service operations efficiently. Use cases may involve managing voice service workflows or responding to customer interactions dynamically.

post.summary: Create an operational action for advanced voice services.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a specific operational action related to advanced voice services in a channel-specific context. It enables integration with various voice service operations efficiently.
